title: Skydive Spaceland Dallas
specs: One of the world’s biggest, most progressive skydiving training centers
Facility includes fully air-conditioned hangar, 40-person bunkhouse, paved runway
Government-issued photo ID required for experienced jumpers
USPA membership card/license required for experienced jumpers
In-date reserve card and seal required if bringing own gear
Rental gear available only for licensed and current jumpers or under direct supervision of instructor
Facility can accommodate up to 11 tandem skydivers on the same flight
Spectators welcome with free parking and covered viewing areas

services.desc: At Skydive Spaceland Dallas, we want you to have the best skydiving experience possible! We’re one of the largest skydiving centers in the world with a purpose-built, private airfield and top-of-the-line everything to ensure you have a safe, exciting, comfortable skydiving experience. Not all drop zones can deliver the same top-quality experience we can, so we’ve put together a comparison of Skydive Spaceland vs. a typical small drop zone below to help you make the best choice when you select your skydiving center.
